title: Samsung Galaxy S10+ not receiving data
symptom: Samsung Galaxy S10+ not receiving data for 10 minutes at a time; if phone isn't turned on then nothing syncs, data backfills afterwards. Some users report no data with screen off, others report intermittent loss even with screen on.
cause: The thread does not establish a single root cause. Possible factors discussed include Samsung-specific power saving features, OB1 collector issues, and Smart Switch migration, but no definitive cause is confirmed.
fix: Several workarounds are suggested: turning off 'Minimize Scanning' in settings, disabling OB1 collector, disabling Samsung power saving features for xDrip, and for MM users disabling 'Trust AutoConnect' or enabling 'Use Scanning'. One user reports success after uninstalling and reinstalling xDrip.
evidence_quote: Got it working by turning the OB1 collector off despite using the G6.
